about: Real per-epoch tracking from scripts/track_training.py: train P1, validate P2, 24-hour (1H) data, width 16, dropout 0.3, weight decay 0.01, seed 42. Epoch 0 = untrained. Hour index 0 = 23 h before the flight, index 23 = flight time.

storm_flight.note: Kp in raw is x10 (83 = 8.3). Peak Kp 8.3 at index 5-7 (18-16 h before).
